mechanismExplanation: The regression stems from the altered **contextPolicy**, which activates aggressive deduplication and context‑compaction steps. After the first `read_file` of a given source, the policy tags the content as “unchanged” and returns only that marker on subsequent reads, while also swapping the full file text for a bounded summary via context compaction. Consequently, later attempts to re‑read the same file yield the unchanged marker or a truncated summary instead of the actual source code, depriving the agent of the detailed information it needs to proceed. This loss of fidelity causes the agent to loop on redundant reads, exhaust its turn budget without making meaningful progress, and ultimately fail the task. The pattern is consistent across all replicated failing runs, confirming the mechanism.
